name: Onee x Shota
source: The protagonist, Daisuke, is a normal boy who attends an all-boys school. When he returns home after summer vacation, he finds that his house has been demolished and his father has left on a journey of self-discovery. He is asked to stay with the Nonomura family, which consists of six sisters. The sisters welcome him, but he struggles to live with them due to his lack of experience with women.
translation: 主人公三井大佑是一名就读于男校的普通少年。暑假结束回到家后，他竟发现家已经被拆，父亲也踏上了寻找自我的旅程。无家可归的大佑被托付给野野村家，在那里居住的是六姐妹。尽管姐妹们都对他表示欢迎，几乎没有与女性相处经验的大佑，还是对这段同居生活感到手足无措。
